title: The artefact coordinates of the helper, the error-map source, the header format and the ordering with the edge are not specified for the implementation
source: Change Register v1 N009 row; Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slides 11, 20 and 49; Ownership Map v1 (idempotency_key owned by PLT); no technical specification exists for the platform library
description: No source fixes the values the implementation must be built on. (a) No slide and no specification names the package name, the registry or the version label of the helper artefact, or the build path of the error-map resource, while Architecture v5 slide 20 only states that every service comes from the template and the shared libraries. (b) No source fixes the header format of Idempotency-Key (length and allowed characters) or the expiry window of a stored response that the filter applies, although Architecture v5 slide 11 requires the header on every POST and a stored response. (c) No source fixes which side stamps the instance member when the gateway answers on the owner's behalf: the edge error envelope is published by RWB-PLT-N001-CON and the pass-through of the owner's code and detail by the same story, but the split of the instance is stated nowhere.
evidence: Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slide 11 (REST: RFC 9457 problem details, Idempotency-Key on every POST, 2 s timeout, one hop), slide 20 (every service from the service template and shared libraries) and slide 49 (OpenTelemetry with W3C Trace Context); Ownership Map v1 idempotency_key row (owner PLT, library object created in every service schema); no technical specification exists for RWB-PLT-LIB and no slide of the deck names the package, the registry, the map path, the header format, the expiry window or the instance side.
owner_role: Platform library lead with the platform architect
proposed: Fix the package, the registry and the version label with the baseline release of RWB-PLT-NF02-APP, fix the map path at the library resource root, read the expiry window and the store timeout as chart configuration with the platform default recorded at the wave 0 review, and record that the owning service stamps instance while the edge passes the code and detail through; record all four before the template pin moves.

title: The published problem-detail schema, the error-map table source, the expiry window and the stored-response scope are not specified for the contract
source: Change Register v1 N009 row; Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slides 11 and 20; Ownership Map v1 (idempotency_key owned by PLT); RWB-PLT-TE006-CON DDL contract; no message catalogue file in the read set
description: The contract cannot copy three of the values it publishes. (a) No source publishes the problem-detail schema beyond the RFC 9457 member set and the media type, and no source names the table the error map is built from or the path of the file shipped with the library. (b) No source fixes the expiry window of a stored response, and no source fixes the exact scope tuple of the response: RWB-PLT-TE006-CON publishes the DDL of idempotency_key with its unique key on the scope and the key, and defines neither the scope contents nor the expiry. (c) The stored-response column set is the TE006 working read and not a field identifier from the data model, so the contract publishes it as the working read and cites the gap.
evidence: Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slide 11 (RFC 9457 problem details; Idempotency-Key on every POST; a stored response per key) and slide 20 (template and shared libraries); Ownership Map v1 idempotency_key row (PLT, library object created in every service schema); RWB-PLT-TE006-CON section 12.7 (DDL template with the unique key on scope and key, no scope contents and no expiry window); the read set holds no message catalogue file and no published error-map schema.
owner_role: Platform library contract owner with the message-catalogue owner
proposed: Publish the schema from the RFC 9457 member set plus the code and traceId members, build the error map from the message catalogue as a data file at the library resource root, fix the scope as the service, the operation and the key, and take the expiry window as a chart value whose platform default is recorded at the wave 0 review.
